The '''Hall of Regret''' was a structure located in a [[City of the Doomed|settlement]] on the polar continent [[Eshkrene]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The Hall was maintained by [[the Doomed]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-wielding group that resided on the continent, and the history of their order was recording on images on the walls of the Hall, which depicted the defeat of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] in the [[Battle of Corbos]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], and the subsequent [[Great Calamity|battle]] between the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] over Kesh that led the ancestors of the Doomed to become stranded on the world. All members of the Doomed would visit the Hall of Regret to remind them of their ancestors' past, which the order considered to be regrettable, and in [[2974 BBY]], the Doomed [[S'kytri]] [[Kaliska (S'kytri)|Kaliska]] escorted the captured Sith [[Takara Hilts]] and [[Parlan Spinner]] into the Hall, to show them her people's origins.
